purpose: Automatically rank exercise substitutes without requiring manual exercise or equipment entry.
hardFilters: exercise equipment must be available at the selected location
exercise must not be excluded by a later user-specific restriction
automatic strength-workout selections must come from the strength category
automatic planner selections must score at least good_substitute; partial/fallback matches stay informational only

homePullingLimitation.appliesWhen: selected location has only bodyweight, yoga_mat and wall
homePullingLimitation.message: The researched catalog contains no good-or-better strength substitute for horizontal pulling or lat pulling with the confirmed Home equipment. Zero2Fit must show the pull slot as unavailable rather than substituting a stretch or unrelated exercise.
